stem:
Kavya cuts a paper rectangle into two pieces and rearranges the pieces into a new shape with no gaps and no overlaps.

Which statement is correct?

options.text: The new shape must have smaller area, because the outline looks different.
Equal area is what forces the new shape to be a rectangle again.
The new shape has the same area as the original rectangle.
Area stays equal even if she throws one piece away before rearranging.

teacher.key_rationale: Cutting and rearranging without gaps or overlaps preserves area. A different outline does not shrink area. Equal area does not force the shape to stay a rectangle. Discarding a piece leaves the exclusion case.
